security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Cluster intelligence and approval-gated remediation for Kubernetes.
bundle.longDescription: Kestrel is a local-first desktop cluster observatory for Kubernetes. It combines live snapshots, deterministic diagnostics, multi-provider AI analysis, and approval-gated remediation in one workspace.
